style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire with comic horror, blazing alpine noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses or fills the lens. Lens blanked nine times; grass and flowers never stop in the wind; she is never still while she speaks
camera_moves: wide; close-ups are brought by the animals and the flying tags, not the camera
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge expressive eyes, stand-up comic energy
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, plays a pan flute and holds an open fan of paper coupons; he never stops playing
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, every one a different bright colour — scarlet, lime, turquoise, orange, violet, gold — each with a big embossed currency sign, no words. COUPONS: a paper fan. FLOWERS: white and yellow, the tags lift off them
prop_continuity: bright butterflies until 7.4; then each turns into a PIRANHA — the wings stay, the body swells into a fish head with bulging goggle eyes and a jaw of small sharp teeth; from 8.4 they stay bitten into her coat
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror is in the teeth, not the light

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 ONE phrase, no break at 5.7; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, paper wings fluttering, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK of the bite at 8.4, then the flute alone

timeline.a: silent. She strides at the lens until her muzzle fills the frame and slams a hoof to her chest, a solemn vow; wind whips the grass past her
she holds the hoof on her chest and rocks her whole body at the lens; the GOAT's fan of coupons pushes in from the right edge
no break. The fan sweeps right across the lens and blanks the frame; the pan flute starts
no break. She throws her head up, her eyes glaze over, and her flank wipes the frame as she swings around after him
silent. The meadow erupts: a swarm of BRIGHT tags lifts off the flowers straight into the lens, blanking it twice, wings beating
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens, covers the whole frame, then flutters off her nose
no break. The tags settle over her in a thick coloured coat, layer on layer, till only her happy squinting eyes are left
silent. She turns her covered head to the lens, the coat rippling, one gold tag beating right at the camera
silent. Every tag turns at once: the bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads, jaws opening, the whole coat churning like a wave
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites into her at once; she jolts up on all fours and the coloured swarm bursts outward and blanks the lens
silent. Her eyes blow wide in comic horror, the grin frozen; the last piranhas rain down past the lens, the goat playing on behind her

must_appear: bright multicoloured butterfly tags, the fan of coupons crossing the lens, tags covering her like a coat, every tag turning into a goggle-eyed piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, words, cyrillic, logos, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, live insects, blood, gore, a second alpaca, slow motion, speed ramp, the alpaca standing still, a talking head with an empty frame, an empty sky with nothing moving, accented Russian, grain
